coreQuestion.es: ¿En qué momento, si alguno, las facultades confiadas a la Administración Concursal para administrar y proteger a LPB y la masa empezaron a funcionar, en la práctica, como un mecanismo que avanzaba, protegía o ejecutaba los objetivos de un perímetro privado adverso?
coreQuestion.en: At what point, if any, did powers entrusted to the insolvency administration to administer and protect LPB and the estate begin functioning in practice as a mechanism that advanced, protected or implemented the objectives of an adverse private perimeter?

terminology.publicEs: hipótesis de agencia funcional / de facto a favor del perímetro adverso
terminology.doctrinalBoundary: Constructive agency is used as a forensic analytical label, not asserted as a standalone named doctrine of Spanish insolvency law. Any formal agency, representation, conflict, invalidity, liability or criminal consequence requires its own legal and evidential basis.

legalAnchors.controlledPoint: The insolvency administration had to perform with the diligence of an orderly administrator and a loyal representative, subject to judicial supervision.
Due diligence, efficient action for the interest of the insolvency, and impartiality and independence from the debtor and insolvency creditors/estate.

legalAnchors.provision: Articles 94 and 98/100 as applicable to current numbering/version
legalAnchors.controlledPoint: Liability for unlawful or undiligent acts/omissions causing harm and separation for serious failure of diligence, impartiality or independence are separate legal consequences requiring act-specific analysis.

fourThresholds.question: When did conduct, if ever, cease to be reasonably reconcilable with loyal administration of LPB and the estate?
When did the administrator know or have reason to recognise that his conduct materially aligned with interests adverse to LPB?
When did the circumstances, if ever, require disclosure, abstention, enhanced judicial scrutiny, replacement/separation or another independence safeguard?
When, if ever, did the pattern move beyond adverse effect or conflict into knowing implementation of objectives that the adverse perimeter needed the administrator's debtor-derived powers to achieve?

temporalStages.label: Pre-CAM predecessor architecture
temporalStages.publicSafeFinding: The 2008 transfer/exploitation architecture later fractured. By 2016 the controlled record shows a Molina-family / Community representative perimeter in direct dispute with LPB-side advisers over debt, access, exploitation and governance.
temporalStages.limit: This does not itself prove that the insolvency administrator represented, colluded with or acted on behalf of that perimeter.

temporalStages.label: Administrator treatment of predecessor positions
temporalStages.publicSafeFinding: The review must determine whether the administrator merely managed the predecessor dispute or progressively validated, protected or operationalised positions adverse to LPB, with what estate benefit and what judicial supervision.
temporalStages.limit: Adverse outcomes, inaction or reliance on Community material do not alone establish agency or knowing joint action.

temporalStages.label: CAM arrival / adoption / escalation hypothesis
temporalStages.publicSafeFinding: Por Derecho alleges that CAM entered a hotel already fractured by a predecessor adverse architecture. The question is whether CAM merely benefited from that history or knowingly adopted, amplified or completed it with support/cooperation from the insolvency administration.
temporalStages.limit: Collusion, agency or criminal agreement is not established by recurrence, succession or benefit alone.

temporalStages.label: Control → liquidation/adjudication → HNT/MYND/finance
temporalStages.publicSafeFinding: Later title, operation and financing must be tested for dependency on earlier administrator-controlled acts without assuming automatic downstream invalidity.
temporalStages.limit: Each downstream act retains its own title, good-faith, registration, standing, causation and limitation analysis.

loyaltyGrades.meaning: Loyal / neutral administration adequately explained by the record
Isolated adverse effect; no alignment inference
Conflict / independence warning signs requiring explanation or safeguard analysis
Strong functional alignment: repeated conduct difficult to reconcile with a loyal estate-interest explanation

Constructive / functional adverse-agency hypothesis: evidence supports knowing implementation of adverse-party objectives using administrator powers, without yet proving a formal mandate or criminal agreement
Direct concerted-action evidence: instructions, formal/informal representation, agreement, consideration, common planning or knowingly coordinated joint action

powerSourceTest.question: Was a power entrusted to the insolvency administrator for LPB/the estate used to produce an outcome an adverse private actor could not itself lawfully produce?
subquestions: What was the source and legal purpose of the administrator's power?
Which adverse-party problem or obstacle did the exercise of that power solve?
Whose factual or legal theory was adopted?
Whose information was relied upon and independently verified?
Who requested or anticipated the act?
Who obtained the immediate and downstream benefit?
What measurable benefit did LPB/the estate receive?
What neutral or loyal alternative was available?
Was conflict disclosed and was abstention or enhanced judicial supervision considered?

whoseProblemTest: whose problem did the act solve
whose legal theory did it adopt
whose information did it rely upon
who could not achieve the result without administrator power
whether it replicated a predecessor-perimeter objective
whether CAM later depended on or benefited from it
whether an independent administrator had a documented estate-interest reason to do the same thing in the same way at that time

art1535ControlledFacts: Cristo Suarez Pimentel originated the LPB workstream.
On 25-Jan-2018 the AC directly terminated Cristo's specific formal LPB mandate and imposed an AC authorisation gate.
By 5-Mar-2018 Borja is recorded as LPB's lawyer and the decree records that LPB requested withdrawal.
CAM did not oppose and DP 1041 ended.
The internal instruction/drafting/filing chain behind withdrawal remains open.
retractoTracks.powerSourceQuestion: CAM, as adverse creditor/acquirer, could not itself terminate LPB's lawyer or control LPB's litigation instructions. The administrator possessed debtor-derived powers. Were those powers exercised for a documented LPB/estate interest or functionally to remove an obstacle confronting the adverse perimeter?
retractoTracks.validityQuestion: If a material loyalty/conflict/independence breakpoint had already occurred before the AC controlled LPB's legal representation, what is the validity and legal effect of the AC intervention and of any later withdrawal or loss of protection that depended upon that conflicted control?

judicialSupervisionQuestion: At what point, if any, should the court have treated the administrator's independence itself as a matter requiring verification or enhanced supervision rather than continuing to rely upon administrator verification or judgment?
downstreamQuestion: If an upstream administrator-controlled act is later found conflicted, unauthorised, ineffective or otherwise legally defective, which later CAM/HNT/MYND/RICPE/RIC/public-funds positions depend upon that act and which survive on an independent legal basis?
consequenceLadder: conflict / loss of independence or impartiality
invalidity / ineffectiveness / unenforceability depending on act type
reduced or contested evidential weight where legally relevant
restoration of lost procedural or economic position where legally available
criminal-investigative significance where constituent facts are separately supported

routeApplications.community_2008_predecessor: Establish the predecessor dispute architecture and identify what was private-party allegation, what became Community act, what the AC knew and what he independently verified.
routeApplications.administrator: Primary loyalty/conflict/independence/constructive-agency dossier; score material acts L0-L6 and apply power-source and estate-benefit tests.
routeApplications.cam_perimeter: Ask what CAM independently created versus inherited/adopted from the predecessor architecture and which administrator-controlled acts made the transition possible.
routeApplications.dp1041_art1535: Test debtor-derived administrator power over LPB counsel and procedural control against estate benefit; preserve the missing withdrawal instruction chain.
routeApplications.takeover_7june: Test whether practical control depended on prior Community machinery or administrator authority and what title existed for each finca/right-holder.
routeApplications.liquidation_adjudication: Ask whether decisive liquidation/adjudication acts occurred after an independence breakpoint and what act-specific consequence follows if so.
routeApplications.judge_institutional: Add judicial-supervision threshold: when should administrator independence/conflict have been independently examined?
routeApplications.downstream_finance: Treat HNT/MYND/RICPE/RIC/public support as downstream dependency analysis, not automatic invalidity.
routeApplications.recovery: Map nullity/ineffectiveness, restitution, unjust enrichment, accounting, damages and restoration by right-holder and act.
